name: PipelineGuidePanel
texts: Pipeline Overviewcrawl dataarrow_forwarddata_collecting.pyarrow_forwarddata_processing.pyarrow_forwardsemantic_understanding.pyarrow_forwardevaluation.pyarrow_forwardrun_pipeline.pyPipeline ExplanationConverted from the Streamlit expanders into native disclosure panels.0. crawl dataexpand_moreCurrent crawler focuses on Threads and receives manual link input.Previous pipeline version primarily targeted comment-based public opinion analysis.1. data_collecting.pyexpand_moreNormalizes schema from JSONL inputs into a stable, model-ready format.Designed to support future expansion into multi-platform collection.2. data_processing.pyexpand_moreCleans spam/noise records and removes structurally low-signal content.Normalizes teencode and slang using a dictionary mapping layer.3. semantic_understanding.pyexpand_moreGenerates PhoBERT embeddings for semantic representation.Embedding similarity supports sentiment inference, topic mapping, and entity signals.4. evaluation.pyexpand_moreCombines sentiment, engagement quality, topic authority, and controversy risk.Outputs the weighted KOL Score used for ranking and comparison.5. run_pipeline.pyexpand_moreExecutes the end-to-end pipeline from ingestion to final scoring artifacts.This stage packages the analysis output for dashboard consumption.Metric MeaningAtomic signals used by the evaluation stage and final score formula.Sentiment Score> 0 indicates positive sentiment dominates negative sentiment in analyzed conversations.Engagement QualityCombines interaction volume and interaction quality from comments, replies, and saves.Topic AuthorityMeasured as dominant topic frequency divided by total topic frequency.Controversy RiskLower risk is better and interpreted as safer brand collaboration potential.KOL ScoreWeighted combination of sentiment, engagement quality, topic authority, and controversy safety.KOL Score FormulaKOL Score = w1 * Sentiment + w2 * Engagement + w3 * Topic Authority + w4 * Controversy SafetyCurrent weights: w1=0.35, w2=0.3, w3=0.2, w4=0.15
